New findings this pass: (1) A community/environmental consultation session on 2025-11-18, organized by North Sinai Governorate at the invitation of GASCO and the environmental consultancy Eco Conserve, covered 'khat izdiwaj al-ghaz bi-shamal Sinai' (the North Sinai gas-line duplication project) — https://almessa.gomhuriaonline.com/626213/ and https://akhbarelyom.com/news/newdetails/4727064/1/. Both articles confirm the companies and North Sinai Governorate location but give no route/km/facility detail. Since P8008 already completed and flowed gas on 2024-06-08 (well before this Nov-2025 consultation), this consultation almost certainly pertains only to the still-under-construction P8009, not P8008 — P8008 is not tied to a fresh EIA/consultation record found anywhere. (2) Downloaded and full-text-searched the EIB EIA for the historically related 'GASCO Abr Sinai Onshore Gas Pipeline' (El-Tina East–El-Arish, 111 km, 32in, EIB project 20070088, PETROSAFE, Nov-2007) — https://www.eib.org/files/pipeline/20070088_eia2_en.pdf. That original design already contained two internal 'LOOP' (duplicate-pipe) sections: LOOP#1 from the start point (km 00+00, agricultural area near El-Sheikh Gaber Canal, west-of-canal side) to km 32+00–33+00 near Romana villages; LOOP#2 from roughly km 84 to the km 111 end point near El-Midan Village (km 102–103) and on to El-Arish. This shows looping/duplicating this exact corridor is a recurring GASCO engineering pattern going back to 2007, but nothing ties the 2024/2025 'izdiwaj' projects to this specific 2007 EIA's loop segments — they could be new loops laid decades later at different km ranges, and no source states which. (3) Found (via Wayback Machine, since the live page now 404s/redirects) a 2020 soutalomma.com article confirming an EARLIER, separate 'Trans-Sinai gas line duplication' totaling 134 km built in two phases, explicitly to serve Sinai's own local consumption — establishing this is a recurring multi-decade capacity-expansion program on the corridor, not a one-off, but again with no named endpoints. (4) EcoConserv's public oil-and-gas project portfolio (ecoconserv.com/oil-gas/) lists several other GASCO EIA jobs (Raven pipeline, Giza North, Dahshour-Atfeeh, Nubaria-Metnama) but nothing Sinai-specific, consistent with the Nov-2025 consultation being too recent to be listed yet. No source anywhere names a specific facility, valve room, or km-point for the 15/15.5 km P8008 segment. Marking unresolved rather than guessing a corridor stretch. Recommended next steps for a future pass: (a) request the EEAA/Eco Conserve scoping document for the Nov-2025 consultation directly (it will very likely give exact km-point termini once public); (b) search the Ministry of Petroleum's and GASCO's own Facebook pages around 2024-06-08 for an inauguration post (these frequently name both tie-in stations); (c) if a fresh session restores WebSearch, target Petrojet/Enppi/Orascom Construction EPC contract-award announcements for 'khat izdiwaj 'abr Sinai'.
